content:
The **Striped Axolotl** is an amphibian in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

A rare amphibian that can be caught with Bait - Improved and Bait - Superb. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 10 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Striped Axolotl (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (25) | 

Can only be caught during the month of August, at any fishing spots in The Mire and Skyline Valley.
